title: How Much Does a Small Business Website Cost in the UK in 2026?
meta_title: Small Business Website Cost UK (2026 Guide)
meta_description: A UK small business website costs £200–£20,000 to build plus £5–£150 a month to run. DIY, freelancer, agency and monthly plan costs over three years.
keywords: how much does a website cost uk
cheap website for small business uk

faq.q: How much does a basic website cost in the UK?
faq.a: A basic five-page UK small business website typically costs £500 to £2,500 from a freelancer or £3,000 or more from an agency, plus £5 to £150 a month for hosting and care.

faq.q: How much does a website cost per month in the UK?
faq.a: Running costs are usually £5 to £150 a month: hosting from about £4, a website builder plan from £9, and a maintenance plan from about £50. Monthly website plans like the Build Fellow cost £69 including everything.

faq.q: Is Wix or Squarespace cheaper than a web designer?
faq.a: Upfront, yes: plans cost roughly £9 to £40 a month. But you do the work, and a basic site typically takes 30 to 60 hours to build well.

faq.q: How long does it take to build a small business website?
faq.a: A simple five-page site usually takes two to six weeks, depending mostly on how quickly copy, photos and feedback are ready.

faq.q: Do I need to pay for website maintenance?
faq.a: Someone has to update software, keep backups and fix security issues. You can do it yourself, but an unmaintained site is a common way small businesses get hacked or go offline.

faq.q: Does a new website help with Google and ChatGPT?
faq.a: Only if it's built for search: fast pages, clear service pages with prices and locations, structured data and a sitemap. Ask for these in writing.
